name: Asahi Co., Ltd.
summary: Asahi Co., Ltd. sells bicycles, parts, accessories, and other related products in Japan. It offers wholesale and retail regular, sports, children's, folding, and electric assist bicycles; and ancillary services, such as maintenance, repair, and other services; and sales of its own branded products to franchised stores. It operates retail and online stores. The company sells its products under the Cycle Base Asahi brand. The company was formerly known as Asahi Gangu and changed its name to Asahi Co., Ltd. in May 1992. Asahi Co., Ltd. was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
